test_add_event_with_relative_time: test adding a scenario event with event_relative_time to schedule messages relative to predecessors
test_add_event_with_absolute_time: test adding a scenario event with event_time to schedule messages at an absolute timestamp
test_add_event_validation: test that add_event raises ValueError for negative times or both time parameters specified
test_edit_event_time_parameters: test editing an existing event to change its event_relative_time or event_time value
test_edit_event_preserve_successors: test that editing an event preserves predecessor and successor DAG relationships correctly
